## Running Code

```{r}
library(readxl)

library(dbscan)
setwd("~/Desktop/Szade_Lab/aktualne")
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# 1. NA -> 0
pca_mat <- df_gated_pct_live %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) %>%
  as.matrix()

# 2. PCA bez log-transform
pca_res <- prcomp(
  pca_mat,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)
```

PCA - ile PC bierzemy?

```{r}
# 2. PCA bez log-transform
pca_res <- prcomp(
  pca_mat,
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = TRUE
)

# procent wariancji wyjaśnionej przez każdy PC
var_explained <- (pca_res$sdev^2) / sum(pca_res$sdev^2)

# w procentach
var_explained_percent <- var_explained * 100

var_explained_percent
```

```{r}
# 3. bierzemy pierwsze 15 PC
pca_data <- pca_res$x[, 1:15, drop = FALSE]
```

```{r}
library(uwot)
# UMAP
umap_res <- uwot::umap(pca_data)

# do ramki danych
umap_df <- data.frame(
  UMAP1 = umap_res[,1],
  UMAP2 = umap_res[,2]
)

head(umap_df)
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Chcę zrobić teraz DBSCAN i wybrać odpowiedni parametr eps, więc zastosuje metodę elbow:

```{r}
library(dbscan)

kNNdistplot(umap_res, k = 5)
abline(h = 0.5, col = "red", lty = 2)
```

```{r}
library(dbscan)

db <- dbscan(umap_res, eps = 0.5, minPts = 5) # wybrane z wykresu elbow powyżej!!!

umap_df$cluster <- as.factor(db$cluster)

ggplot(umap_df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Shannon Index

```{r}
shannon_index <- function(x) {
  x <- x[x > 0]              
  p <- x / sum(x)         
  -sum(p * log(p))
}

df_clusters$shannon <- apply(
  df_gated_pct_live,
  1,
  shannon_index
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(df_clusters, aes(x = cluster, y = shannon, fill = cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Shannon diversity per cluster")
```

```{r}
kruskal.test(shannon ~ cluster, data = df_clusters)
```

```{r}
df_clusters %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(mean_shannon = mean(shannon))
```

Profil fenotypowy klastra

```{r}
df_clusters <- df_gated_pct_live %>%
  mutate(cluster = as.factor(db$cluster))

cluster_means <- df_clusters %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
library(tibble)

# globalne średnie i SD
global_mean <- colMeans(df_gated_pct_live, na.rm = TRUE)
global_sd   <- apply(df_gated_pct_live, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)

# funkcja do z-score
zscore <- function(x, mean, sd) {
  (x - mean) / sd
}

# profil fenotypowy (z-score)
cluster_profile <- cluster_means %>%
  column_to_rownames("cluster") %>%
  as.matrix()

cluster_profile_z <- sweep(cluster_profile, 2, global_mean, "-")
cluster_profile_z <- sweep(cluster_profile_z, 2, global_sd, "/")
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

pheatmap(
  cluster_profile_z,
  scale = "none",
  clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",
  clustering_distance_cols = "euclidean",
  main = "Phenotypic profile of clusters (z-score)"
)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

cluster_long <- as.data.frame(cluster_profile_z) %>%
  rownames_to_column("cluster") %>%
  pivot_longer(-cluster, names_to = "feature", values_to = "z")

# top 5 ↑ i ↓ dla każdego klastra
top_features <- cluster_long %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  arrange(desc(z)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  bind_rows(
    cluster_long %>%
      group_by(cluster) %>%
      arrange(z) %>%
      slice_head(n = 5)
  )
```

**Louvain Clustering**

```{r}
library(RANN)
library(igraph)

set.seed(123)

#graf kNN
k <- 10

knn <- nn2(pca_data, k = k + 1)  

edges <- data.frame(
  from = rep(seq_len(nrow(pca_data)), each = k),
  to = as.vector(knn$nn.idx[, -1])
)
```

```{r}
#graf igraph
distances <- as.vector(knn$nn.dists[, -1])

edges$weight <- 1 / (distances + 1e-6)

g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = FALSE)
E(g)$weight <- edges$weight
```

```{r}
#louvain clustering
louvain <- cluster_louvain(g, weights = E(g)$weight)
cluster_louvain <- membership(louvain)
```

```{r}
#dodanie klastrów do df
df$cluster_louvain <- factor(cluster_louvain)

#sprawdzenie liczebności klastrów
df$cluster_louvain <- factor(cluster_louvain)
```

```{r}
df_umap <- data.frame(
  UMAP1 = umap_res[, 1],
  UMAP2 = umap_res[, 2],
  cluster_louvain = factor(cluster_louvain)
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(df_umap, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = cluster_louvain)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Louvain clusters on UMAP",
    color = "Louvain cluster"
  )
```

```{r}
library(RANN)
library(igraph)
library(ggplot2)

run_louvain <- function(pca_data, umap_res, k = 10, pcs_label = "PCs") {
  
  knn <- nn2(pca_data, k = k + 1)
  
  edges <- data.frame(
    from = rep(seq_len(nrow(pca_data)), each = k),
    to = as.vector(knn$nn.idx[, -1]),
    distance = as.vector(knn$nn.dists[, -1])
  )
  
  edges$weight <- 1 / (edges$distance + 1e-6)
  
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges, directed = FALSE)
  g <- simplify(g, edge.attr.comb = "mean")
  
  cl <- cluster_louvain(g, weights = E(g)$weight)
  cluster <- factor(membership(cl))
  
  df_plot <- data.frame(
    UMAP1 = umap_res[, 1],
    UMAP2 = umap_res[, 2],
    cluster = cluster
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(UMAP1, UMAP2, color = cluster)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = paste0("Louvain: k = ", k, ", ", pcs_label))
  
  print(table(cluster))
  print(p)
}
```

```{r}
run_louvain(pca_res$x[, 1:5],  umap_res, k = 5,  pcs_label = "PC1-5")
run_louvain(pca_res$x[, 1:5],  umap_res, k = 10, pcs_label = "PC1-5")
run_louvain(pca_res$x[, 1:10], umap_res, k = 5,  pcs_label = "PC1-10")
run_louvain(pca_res$x[, 1:10], umap_res, k = 10, pcs_label = "PC1-10")
run_louvain(pca_res$x[, 1:15], umap_res, k = 5,  pcs_label = "PC1-15")
```

```{r}
)
```


**Leiden Clustering**

```{r}
library(RANN)
library(igraph)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(123)

# 15 PC
pca_data_15 <- pca_res$x[, 1:15, drop = FALSE]

# graf kNN
k <- 10

knn <- RANN::nn2(pca_data_15, k = k + 1)

edges <- data.frame(
  from = rep(seq_len(nrow(pca_data_15)), each = k),
  to = as.vector(knn$nn.idx[, -1]),
  distance = as.vector(knn$nn.dists[, -1])
)

# wagi: bliższe punkty = silniejsze połączenie
edges$weight <- 1 / (edges$distance + 1e-6)

# graf
g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
  edges,
  directed = FALSE
)

# usuwamy ewentualne pętle i duplikaty
g <- igraph::simplify(
  g,
  remove.multiple = TRUE,
  remove.loops = TRUE,
  edge.attr.comb = list(weight = "mean")
)

# Leiden z igraph
leiden_ig <- igraph::cluster_leiden(
  g,
  weights = igraph::E(g)$weight,
  resolution_parameter = 0.05
)

# członkostwo klastrów
leiden_clusters <- igraph::membership(leiden_ig)

# dodanie do df_umap
df_umap$cluster_leiden <- as.factor(leiden_clusters)

# liczebność klastrów
table(df_umap$cluster_leiden)

# modularity
igraph::modularity(g, membership(leiden_ig), weights = igraph::E(g)$weight)

# UMAP z klastrami Leiden
ggplot(df_umap, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, color = cluster_leiden)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Leiden clustering on PCA space, visualized on UMAP",
    color = "Leiden cluster"
  )
```

```{r}
for (res in c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0)) {
  
  leiden_ig <- igraph::cluster_leiden(
    g,
    weights = igraph::E(g)$weight,
    resolution_parameter = res
  )
  
  cl <- igraph::membership(leiden_ig)
  
  cat("\nResolution:", res, "\n")
  cat("Number of clusters:", length(unique(cl)), "\n")
  cat("Modularity:", igraph::modularity(g, cl, weights = igraph::E(g)$weight), "\n")
  print(table(cl))
}
```
